questions.q: If 13 is changed to ==53== in 4, 7, 7, 9, 13, what happens?
choices: Both the mean and the median rise
The mean rises to 16 and the median stays 7
The median rises and the mean stays 8

questions.explain_ar: المجموع يصبح 80 فالمتوسط 16، والقيمة الوسطى تبقى 7.

It is in the data's own units
